t: Customer Reviews of Perplexus Epic by Spinmaster
s: Perplexus toys are always a hit. I have had a few sizes and the kids love them, even adults will pick them up and play for a bit. The epic is large and requires a bit more extended concentration and motor skills than some of the smaller ones so I would avoid giving it to very young children. For the bigger kids though, it keeps them engaged and has, surprisingly, turned out to be a group toy as they try to outdo each other. I buy them as gifts for my kids' friends because it's such a hit.
